chunks: I asked al-Reza (peace be upon him)
about the word of God the Exalted: 'And signs; and by the star they are being guided' [16:16]
He said: 'We are the signs, and the star is the Messenger of God (may God's blessings be upon him and his family).'

key_terms.الرِّضَا: al-Reza — laqab (title) of the eighth Imam 'Ali ibn Musa al-Reza (AS)
key_terms.النَّجْمُ: the star — the Imam interprets the star in Q.16:16 as the Prophet Muhammad (SAWW)
key_terms.الْعَلَامَاتُ: signs/landmarks — the Imam interprets this Quranic word as referring to the Imams themselves as divinely placed guides

ai.seo_question: What do the 'signs' and 'star' in Quran 16:16 refer to according to Imam al-Reza?
ai.summary: Al-Washsha' narrates that he asked Imam al-Reza (AS) to interpret Quran 16:16, where God mentions 'signs' and 'the star' as means of guidance. The Imam authoritatively declared that the Imams of the Ahl al-Bayt are the 'signs' of guidance, while the Prophet Muhammad (SAWW) is 'the star.' This interpretation frames the Imamate as a divinely ordained institution through which humanity finds its way, just as ancient travelers navigated by celestial landmarks.
